name: academia-iat
description: Plataforma local de estudo e consulta do POP de licenciamento hidrelétrico.

scripts.build: node tools/sanitize-public-data.mjs --check && node tools/build-offline-packages.mjs --check && vite build && node tools/build-sw.mjs dist && node tools/check-bundle.mjs dist
scripts.test: vitest run && node tools/sanitize-public-data.mjs --check && node tools/test-pwa.mjs && node tools/build-offline-packages.mjs --check && node tools/security-check.mjs && node tools/check-provenance.mjs && node tools/check-referencias.mjs && node tools/check-rubricas.mjs && node tools/check-questoes.mjs && node tools/check-videoaulas.mjs && node tools/audit-lessons.mjs && node tools/smoke-test.mjs
scripts.build:pages: vite build --outDir dist-pages && node tools/build-sw.mjs dist-pages $PAGES_REPO && node tools/check-bundle.mjs dist-pages
